author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Simple moments, real flavors, and cooking close to nature 🌿🔥🍞 In this video, we gather wild herbs and turn them into a delicious flatbread cooked over an open fire.

The dough is soft and rustic, infused with fresh greens that add a natural аромат and earthy taste. As it cooks on the fire, the flatbread develops a light crisp outside while staying tender inside.

This is true village simplicity — foraged ingredients, handmade dough, and fire cooking. A beautiful reminder that the best meals don’t need much, just fresh herbs, a bit of skill, and a connection to nature.
title: Simple Village Life: Wild Herb Flatbread on Fire 🌿🔥🍞
